name: Gravity Gun Effects
description: The Gravity Gun's effects and sounds on everyone's screen: a soft glow in its core at rest; a beam from its muzzle, twisting with energy, that bends like a whip to what it holds; a ring and sparks where it catches; a bubble round the held thing with motes rising through it; a ragdoll dangling from the limb it grabbed (with the Ragdoll Add-On); and sounds for reaching, grabbing, holding and letting go.
